hints.title: Contiguous Run Encoding
hints.text: Group identical consecutive characters into runs of ones and zeros to observe block transitions.

hints.title: Trade Benefit
hints.text: Erasing an interior run of ones merges the adjacent runs of zeros into a single larger zero block that converts into ones.

hints.title: Maximize Adjacent Zero Sum
hints.text: The net gain from the optimal trade equals the maximum sum of lengths of any two consecutive runs of zeros separated by ones.

hints.title: Complete Implementation

complexity.notes: Two-pointer traversal scans blocks in linear time with constant memory.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Evaluating trades at every position individually yields quadratic runtime.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Running state variables eliminate array allocation.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Recognize run-length block merging and track consecutive zero block sums.
